phases.name: Local-first environment certification and production-safe promotion
phases.objective: Certify Local/Dev first, introduce the approved four-plan test billing contract, then certify Staging before any Production preparation.
exit_criteria: Local/Dev runs from development with a dedicated Neon database.
Stable plan IDs starter, growth, pro, unlimited are implemented with monthly USD 10.99, 19.99, 34.99, 54.99 and 10-day trials in Shopify test mode.
Dedicated Staging Shopify identity is verified.
Staging Worker, PostgreSQL and Queue/DLQ are healthy.
Staging Shopify auth/session/Admin API and four-plan billing checks pass.
Production remains unmodified until Staging acceptance evidence exists.

phases.name: Four-plan billing and entitlement architecture
phases.objective: Turn the approved commercial catalog into authoritative server-side entitlement behavior and safe subscription transitions.
exit_criteria: All four plans map to deterministic capability entitlements.
Upgrade/downgrade/cancel/legacy paths are verified.
Plans UX matches canonical product plan.

phases.name: Sorting and merchandising correctness
phases.objective: Make stock-first sorting scalable, reversible and more configurable than single-purpose competitors.
exit_criteria: Advanced sorting, pinning/exclusions and restore behavior are verified.
Queue/API-limit behavior is resilient.

phases.name: Product visibility automation
phases.objective: Add safe soft-hide, unpublish and restock recovery workflows.
exit_criteria: Visibility actions are reversible/recoverable and entitlement-gated.

phases.name: Variant and multi-location automation
phases.objective: Add sold-out variant control and explicit location-aware inventory semantics.
exit_criteria: Variant/multi-location behavior passes integration and edge-case tests.

phases.name: Inventory alerts and notifications
phases.objective: Deliver low/out-of-stock email, Slack and digest workflows with deduplication and reliability.
exit_criteria: Alert thresholds, integrations and failure recovery are verified.

phases.name: Advanced automation rule engine
phases.objective: Provide deterministic IF/AND/THEN rules, scheduling, delays, precedence and explainability.
exit_criteria: Rules are deterministic, conflict-safe, explainable and idempotent.

phases.name: Analytics, history and merchant operations
phases.objective: Add dashboard, history, error/retry/rollback and export surfaces.
exit_criteria: Operational outcomes are auditable and reports reconcile to source data.

phases.name: Markets, B2B and integrations
phases.objective: Add enterprise-context merchandising plus guarded external integration surfaces.
exit_criteria: Markets/catalog/channel isolation is verified.
Integration contracts are secure and entitlement-gated.

phases.name: Security, scale and production certification
phases.objective: Certify the complete product under security, scale, staging and guarded Production release gates.
exit_criteria: Security and scale gates pass.
Full Staging certification passes.
Production is released only from exact certified evidence with explicit authorization.

work_units.objective: Install repository-backed project state, role routing, coordination, risk, release, audit and governance registries.
acceptance_criteria: config/ai/project-state.json is canonical and repository-specific.
Issue #32 is the active work anchor.
AGENTS/manifest route Supervisor/Worker roles through repository state.
Existing application/deployment code is unchanged.

work_units.title: Set up and certify Local Dev with Neon
work_units.objective: Run VSN | Stock Down Sort Dev from development using an isolated Neon PostgreSQL database before Staging work.
blockers: Dedicated Neon project vsn-stock-down-sort-local is not yet provisioned/bound with a real project ID and endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: development is the Local integration branch.
npm run dev uses VSN | Stock Down Sort Dev.
DATABASE_URL is a Neon pooled connection.
DIRECT_URL is the matching Neon direct connection.
Prisma migrations pass on the Local Neon database.
Local credentials do not reuse Staging or Production database identities.
completion_evidence: PR #37 App Validation run 36698394720 passed repository checks.
Local-first topology is present in protected main.
Actual Local Neon binding/live dev acceptance remains pending.

work_units.title: Replace legacy single-plan test contract with approved four-plan catalog
work_units.objective: Implement and locally verify exact starter/growth/pro/unlimited recurring test billing using 10-day trials before Staging acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Stable IDs are starter, growth, pro, unlimited.
Monthly prices are USD 10.99, 19.99, 34.99 and 54.99 respectively.
Every plan uses a 10-day trial.
Local billing remains Shopify test mode.
Legacy USD 55 / 5-day runtime contract is removed or explicitly migrated without breaking existing subscription handling.

work_units.title: Verify staging environment secret contract
work_units.objective: After Local and four-plan billing contract certification, prove required cloudflare-staging values are configured without exposing them.
blockers: Local/Dev and billing contract certification must complete first.
acceptance_criteria: Environment Secrets Audit passes for staging.

work_units.title: Run Staging Readiness
work_units.objective: Validate migrations, build, identity isolation and staging contract before deployment.
acceptance_criteria: Staging Readiness completes successfully.

work_units.title: Manually deploy Cloudflare Staging
work_units.objective: Deploy exact development source through the guarded manual staging workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Cloudflare Staging Deploy passes.
Queue and DLQ exist and bind correctly.

work_units.title: Certify staging runtime, Shopify acceptance and four-plan test billing
work_units.objective: Verify health, database, queues, sessions, Admin GraphQL and exact four-plan test billing reads/creation.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime health passes.
Signed staging acceptance passes against isolated test shop.
All four stable plan IDs/prices use 10-day trial in test mode.

work_units.title: Create and release Staging Shopify version
work_units.objective: Release the exact verified staging Shopify configuration only.
acceptance_criteria: Exact staging candidate created and released.
Local and Production configs remain untouched.

work_units.title: Prepare reviewed production candidate after Staging acceptance
work_units.objective: Allow production preparation only after all Staging acceptance evidence is recorded.
acceptance_criteria: Staging phase is accepted before production preparation starts.

work_units.title: Build server-side entitlement engine
work_units.objective: Map active Shopify plan to selected option IDs and enforce access on server actions.
acceptance_criteria: Every protected capability checks server-side entitlements.
Unknown/invalid plans fail closed.

work_units.title: Implement upgrade, downgrade, cancel and legacy compatibility
work_units.objective: Make subscription transitions deterministic and preserve a safe path from legacy subscriptions.
acceptance_criteria: Transitions are explicit and tested.
Legacy subscription state never silently grants the wrong tier.

work_units.title: Align Plans UX and feature gates
work_units.objective: Render the four plans, ten-day trials and capability-aware upgrade prompts.
acceptance_criteria: Plans UI matches canonical product-plan.json.
Locked features explain required tier without bypassing server gates.

work_units.title: Certify stock-first sorting correctness at scale
work_units.objective: Audit current ordering, Shopify API limits and large-catalog behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Ordering is deterministic across large collections.
API throttling is handled without false success.

work_units.title: Add exclusions, pinning and advanced sort strategies
work_units.objective: Implement approved merchandising controls while preserving stock-first invariants.
acceptance_criteria: Excluded/pinned products behave deterministically.
Restore remains reversible.

work_units.title: Harden queues, retries and idempotency
work_units.objective: Certify webhook/queue durability, DLQ recovery and concurrency behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate events do not duplicate harmful mutations.
Failures are recoverable and observable.

work_units.title: Implement SEO-safe soft hide
work_units.objective: Allow collection/search merchandising removal while preserving product URL where supported.
acceptance_criteria: Soft hide has a previewable/reversible state model.

work_units.title: Implement hard hide/unpublish and restock republish
work_units.objective: Automate publication changes with preserved prior-state evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Hard hide and republish are reversible where Shopify permits.
Protected/excluded items are not mutated.

work_units.title: Certify visibility failure recovery
work_units.objective: Add retry/error handling and merchant-visible recovery evidence.
acceptance_criteria: No failed visibility action is reported as successful.

work_units.title: Implement sold-out variant hide/restore
work_units.objective: Apply variant visibility rules and automatically restore on restock.
acceptance_criteria: Variant state transitions are deterministic and reversible.

work_units.title: Implement multi-location inventory semantics
work_units.objective: Define and enforce how location inventory contributes to rule conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Location aggregation is explicit and tested.

work_units.title: Harden variant edge cases
work_units.objective: Cover mixed availability, tracking-disabled variants and concurrent stock changes.
acceptance_criteria: Edge cases fail safely without hiding valid inventory.

work_units.title: Implement low/out-of-stock email rules
work_units.objective: Add thresholds, recipients, deduplication and delivery history.
acceptance_criteria: Threshold alerts are deterministic and deduplicated.

work_units.title: Add Slack and scheduled digests
work_units.objective: Deliver eligible alerts to Slack and scheduled summaries for entitled plans.
acceptance_criteria: Integration secrets are protected.
Failures are visible and retryable.

work_units.title: Certify notification reliability
work_units.objective: Test retries, rate limits and noisy inventory-update suppression.
acceptance_criteria: Delivery reliability has evidence under failure/load.

work_units.title: Build deterministic rule model and evaluator
work_units.objective: Implement versioned IF/AND/THEN rules against approved conditions/actions.
acceptance_criteria: Same inputs produce same rule decisions.
Invalid actions are rejected before mutation.

work_units.title: Add schedules, delays and chained recovery actions
work_units.objective: Support time-based execution such as push down then soft hide then restore.
acceptance_criteria: Scheduled/delayed actions are idempotent and cancelable where required.

work_units.title: Implement conflict precedence and explainability
work_units.objective: Resolve overlapping rules predictably and show why an action occurred.
acceptance_criteria: Conflict resolution is explicit and test-covered.

work_units.title: Build merchant dashboard and activity history
work_units.objective: Expose stock health, automation outcomes and auditable activity records.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard metrics reconcile with stored execution data.

work_units.title: Add error center, retry and rollback controls
work_units.objective: Surface failed actions and guarded recovery paths.
acceptance_criteria: Retries/rollback never claim success without verified outcome.

work_units.title: Add reports and CSV export
work_units.objective: Provide entitled inventory and automation exports.
acceptance_criteria: Exports match filtered source data.

work_units.title: Implement Markets/catalog/channel-aware rules
work_units.objective: Add supported Shopify Markets, B2B catalog and publication-channel semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Rules do not leak visibility across unintended contexts.

work_units.title: Implement guarded API and webhook integrations
work_units.objective: Expose authenticated/replay-safe integration contracts for entitled plans.
acceptance_criteria: API/webhooks enforce entitlement, auth and rate limits.

work_units.title: Certify enterprise-context behavior
work_units.objective: Test multi-market, catalog and channel combinations with recovery evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Enterprise contexts have deterministic acceptance evidence.

work_units.title: Run security/privacy threat model and dependency assurance
work_units.objective: Review Shopify auth, billing, webhooks, database, Cloudflare, Actions, integrations and data minimization.
acceptance_criteria: Critical security findings are resolved or explicitly blocked.

work_units.title: Certify scale, API limits and failure recovery
work_units.objective: Run high-volume catalog, queue, retry and rate-limit certification.
acceptance_criteria: High-volume operation does not corrupt ordering or visibility state.

work_units.title: Run full Staging product certification
work_units.objective: Verify all four plans, entitlements and implemented modules against isolated Staging.
acceptance_criteria: Staging acceptance covers billing, entitlements, core workflows and recovery.

work_units.title: Prepare and release guarded Production candidate
work_units.objective: Promote exact certified source only after explicit release authorization and verify post-release health.
acceptance_criteria: Production release is explicitly authorized.
Post-release verification passes or rollback is executed.
